messages:
rachel: Heads up  CloudSummit NA (NYC) confirmed: booth D12, partner panel slot May 22 at 11:30. Need to finalize panelists, run-of-show, AV capture plan, and swag handout policy. Can we triage? :loudspeaker:

devin: I'll own panel lineup with AtlasEdge and BlueBridge. Asking for a 20min panel + 10min live Q&A. Want two engineers and one PM from our side. Who's available?

marco: I can do the engineer spot at 11:30. Happy to demo a fast failover between Dedicated and Hosted in ~3m. Will need wired ethernet and HDMI. Note: AtlasEdge asked for an architecture slide with latency numbers.

lin: Events/logistics  booth power is single 15A circuit. AV: projector + lapel mic available if requested by May 10. We can record the panel but need a signed consent form for all participants and a public release for clip usage. Ops-bot will add a reminder.

emily: Swag constraints: venue allows only distributed items under 75 EUR value. Recommend stickers, socks, and single-use promo cards with QR for trial credits. Number suggestion: 500 stickers, 250 socks, 300 trial cards. Also no battery-powered swag unless pre-cleared.

marco: For the live demo I'll bring a small NUC with a local NVMe and an ethernet dongle. Fallback plan: pre-record a 90s screen capture showing failover. Command to reproduce locally: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-2b","prompt":"hello"}'```

rachel: Panel run-of-show draft:
- 11:20 crew mic check
- 11:30 intro + 5min partner intros
- 11:35 10min engineering demos (2x 5min)
- 11:45 5min live failover demo
- 11:50 10min audience Q&A
- 12:00 wrap + CTA
Please flag timing changes by EOD Thu.

lin: Consent form link: https://notion.redwood/events/consent-template. We'll need each speaker to sign and return by May 15. Also we'll place a sign at the booth noting "Recording in progress" per venue rules.

ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-4823 (CloudSummit booth AV & recording). Owner: lin. Due: 2026-05-10.

devin: Action items: lin to reserve lapel mic + recorder, emily to finalize swag vendor by May 5, marco to upload demo video by May 12, rachel to collect signed consent forms by May 15. I'll coordinate panel slides with partners.

rachel: Thanks all. Quick ask to marketing: please draft 1 co-branded social post and a 90s highlight clip template if we get recording. Tagging them in the document. :camera_flash:
